parsed_output.email_body:
Dear Hu Kitchen Team,

I hope this email finds you well. Our team has been closely following Hu Kitchen's success in the paleo-fast food space in New York City. We believe there is an opportunity to further engage your audience through a collaborative Instagram post. Our idea is to create a behind-the-scenes look at Hu Kitchen's kitchen, showcasing the daily operations and unique ingredients used in your dishes. This would not only highlight your unique offerings but also engage a wider audience interested in paleo-inspired fast food.

We would love to discuss this idea further and explore how we can work together to bring this concept to life.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
